clue.text: Like, essentially, to spread malicious rumours

parts.note: as means like, in the same way
per se means in itself, essentially

explanation.surface: A gossip column instruction: spread malicious rumours, more or less.
explanation.definitionFit: To asperse is to slander someone, casting damaging aspersions on their character.

clue.text: Edible fungus — upset after eating it?

indicators.note: eating means taking in, so one piece swallows the other

parts.note: to shake someone is to upset them

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a mushroom left someone queasy after a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Shiitake is a Japanese mushroom widely used in cooking, here in a variant spelling.

clue.text: Last vestige of topped limb

indicators.note: topped means having the top cut off, so the first letter goes

parts.note: an arm or leg is a member of the body

explanation.surface: All that remains of a tree branch that was lopped.
explanation.definitionFit: An ember is a glowing remnant of a fire, its last trace.

clue.text: Thomas the Tank, perhaps, cradling Controller's head

indicators.note: cradling means holding within, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a septic tank treats sewage

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Thomas the Tank Engine carrying the Fat Controller, his railway boss.
explanation.walkthrough: Doubting Thomas, the apostle who wanted proof, is the example 'perhaps' marks. Thomas the Tank Engine is a children's TV train.
explanation.definitionFit: Doubting Thomas refused to believe without evidence, so he is a model doubter.

clue.text: Vie for domestic income?

indicators.note: the first half of income signals that one piece goes inside the other, its second half

parts.note: the second part of the word income, taken as written
a pet is a domestic animal, such as a household cat

explanation.surface: A couple competing over who brings home the household money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Income' reads as earnings, but it must be split in two: its first half is the container signal and its second half the outer piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To vie is to strive against rivals, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Pop a question that's not entirely obscure

indicators.note: not entirely says only part of the phrase is used, letters from within it

explanation.surface: Proposing marriage, but in a roundabout way.
explanation.definitionFit: Opaque means not transparent, hard to understand, so obscure.

clue.text: Collage of meat-eating vigilantes, top to toe

indicators.note: eating means taking in, so the meat surrounds the other piece

parts.note: pork is a meat

indicators.note: the top letter of the word is moved to the bottom, its end

parts.note: a watch is a body of people keeping guard

explanation.surface: A collage portraying carnivorous vigilantes, from head to foot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top to toe' sounds like the whole picture, but it moves the first letter of the vigilantes to their end before the meat goes round them.
explanation.definitionFit: Patchwork is a piecing together of assorted scraps, like a collage.

clue.text: Blue or turquoise top causing ruction

indicators.note: the top of a word in a down clue is its first letter
causing a ruction stirs things up, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A clash over whether a top is blue or turquoise.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruction is a noisy disturbance or row, a kind of trouble.

clue.text: Port drunk with chasers -— it gets you very high

indicators.note: drunk means intoxicated, so the letters reel into a new order

explanation.surface: Port followed by chasers will get anyone very drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'high' looks like intoxication; it means elevated.
explanation.definitionFit: Stratospheric means extremely high, as in the upper atmosphere or soaring prices.

clue.text: Member taking nothing from nowhere

indicators.note: taking one thing from another means it is removed, here the zero
from marks the word that loses the letter, the place of oblivion

parts.note: limbo is a state of being nowhere, forgotten and in between
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A politician gaining nothing from a seat in the middle of nowhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A limb, such as an arm or leg, is a member of the body.

clue.text: Something dentist may have to do with lineage

definitions.text: Something dentist may have to do
definitions.meaning: pulling a tooth is a procedure a dentist may perform
descent or ancestry, as in of Irish origin

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both pulling out a tooth and ancestry or descent, two separate senses.

clue.text: Repeat usual rubbish

parts.note: par is the usual or normal level, as in 'par for the course'
rot means nonsense, rubbish

explanation.surface: Someone dismissing a familiar line as the usual old rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: To repeat words mechanically, as a talking bird does, is a verb sense.

clue.text: A friend in America with endless addiction to emirate

parts.note: bud is American slang for buddy, a friend

indicators.note: endless says the last letter of the word for addiction is dropped

parts.note: a habit is an addiction, as in a drug habit

explanation.surface: An American friend whose addiction draws them to a Gulf state.
explanation.definitionFit: Abu Dhabi is the largest of the seven United Arab Emirates, so an example.

clue.text: Member of clergy apprehending fairy inverted in mirror

indicators.note: apprehending means catching and holding, so one piece is held inside the other

parts.note: a rector is a parish priest

indicators.note: inverted says the word for fairy is read backwards

parts.note: an elf is a fairy creature

explanation.surface: A vicar arresting an upside-down fairy in a looking glass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Member' recalls 10 Across's limb, but here it is part of the phrase for a clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: A reflector is any surface that throws back light, such as a mirror.

clue.text: Crustacean to depose government before entering thoroughfare

indicators.note: entering means going inside, so the pieces go into the road

parts.note: a lane is a road or route

indicators.note: before places the government letter ahead of the other piece

parts.note: to oust is to remove from power, depose

explanation.surface: A political coup marching down the street, with a lobster appearing.
explanation.definitionFit: A langouste is a spiny lobster, a large crustacean.

clue.text: Stick to game

definitions.meaning: a metal rod for stirring a fire
a card game played for stakes

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the fireside rod and the card game, two distinct senses.

clue.text: Introduction to Strange Fruitcake?

indicators.note: the introduction to a word is its opening letter

parts.note: a cone is the fruit of a conifer, such as a pine cone

explanation.surface: An odd person is labelled a fruitcake, a strange one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fruitcake' must be split: FRUIT gives CONE and CAKE is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A scone is a small British baked cake, often eaten with jam and cream.

clue.text: V-sign scrawled on her CV

indicators.note: scrawled means written messily, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A rude gesture scribbled on someone's job application.
explanation.walkthrough: A V-sign is a rude British hand gesture, but here it is a V-shaped stripe.
explanation.definitionFit: A chevron is a V-shaped mark, such as a stripe on a uniform sleeve.

clue.text: Sellers, turning round recreational area, left fire extinguisher

indicators.note: round says the reversed sellers go around the other pieces
turning says the word for sellers is read backwards

parts.note: reps are sales representatives
a rink is an area for skating

explanation.walkthrough: 'Sellers' looks like the comic actor Peter Sellers; 'turning' gives SPER, which splits round the area and the L.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprinkler is a ceiling device that sprays water to put out fires.

clue.text: Wrung this headless bird's neck

indicators.note: wrung means twisted, so the letters are twisted into a new order
headless says the first letter is dropped

parts.note: emu's, the possessive of the flightless Australian bird

explanation.surface: Wringing a beheaded bird's neck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neck' sounds like the bird's; it is a narrow strip of land.
explanation.definitionFit: An isthmus is a narrow neck of land joining two larger areas.

clue.text: Put out electronic message, not initially vulgar

indicators.note: not initially means the opening letter is dropped

parts.note: a text is an electronic message sent by phone
rude means vulgar, coarse

explanation.surface: Posting an online message that is, at first glance, not vulgar.
explanation.definitionFit: To extrude is to force or push something out.

clue.text: Progenitor's yearly charge

parts.note: PA is short for per annum, yearly
rent is a charge paid for use of property

explanation.surface: An ancestor paying an annual fee.
explanation.definitionFit: A progenitor is a forebear, and a mother or father is the nearest one.

clue.text: French paper absorbing a drink

indicators.note: absorbing means taking in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Le Monde is a leading French daily newspaper

explanation.surface: A French newspaper soaking up a spilled drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Lemonade is a soft drink flavoured with lemons.

clue.text: Left to replace inner parts of Tchaikovsky score

parts.note: went means left, departed

explanation.walkthrough: Only the T and Y of Tchaikovsky survive; WENT fills the middle. 'Score' is the number, not the music.
explanation.definitionFit: A score is a set of twenty, as in threescore years and ten.

clue.text: Wipe out head of regiment in comfort

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: ease means comfort, as in at ease

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Destroying a regiment's commander while relaxing in comfort.
explanation.definitionFit: To erase is to delete, remove all trace of, wipe out.

clue.text: Piano music Nero performed in front of stage

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

indicators.note: performed means acted out, reworked, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Soft music performed by the emperor Nero at the front of a stage.
explanation.definitionFit: The proscenium is the part of a theatre stage in front of the curtain.

clue.text: Debate quelling monarch's fever

parts.note: to argue is to debate
R is short for rex or regina, a king or queen

clue.text: Food and drink obtained from catering establishment

indicators.note: obtained from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Food and drink supplied by a restaurant or caterer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ingesta is a technical term for whatever is taken into the body as nourishment.

clue.text: Compound of steel, sulphur and oxygen creating problem for horse

parts.note: O is the chemical symbol for oxygen
S is the chemical symbol for sulphur

indicators.note: a compound mixes elements, so the letters are blended together in a new order

explanation.surface: A chemistry lesson on a steel compound causing a horse trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: An osselet is a bony growth on a horse's fetlock joint, causing lameness.
